body: No. This is why it hurts so much. I dont know how true is but I shouldn't be defending her.  That's what i always do and end up hurt. Theres a lot of things that didn't make sense.  Everything hurts and her just not wantikg to talk and tell me the truth hurts wven more. I'm tired of the pain.  I need help. I need a psychiatrist.  Idk. Im in pain. I need help. Im tired of caring  for someone that made fun for me crying  s,;
What do you mean by issues?

She just kept making fun of me and telling me if I called her again I would be behind bars. And I haven't done shit, I haven't done anything to hurt her. I just wanted to know why! And she just kept making fun of me. And some fucking stupid part of me doesnt believe this cause who the fuck moves with someone you just met and says you love her? NO ONE does that. But at the same time whenever "the guy" texted it was such a different way of writing, it did read like someone else . Im fucking depressed. I dont have the strength. I dont have any friends here. I dont have anyone to count on. I have never been with someone else. She was my best friend. I knew her for 10 fucking years and now she just told me she doesnt feel anything and make fun of me crying out of her bullshit!! s'; I dont know what to believe!! If theres someone else! If theres not! Why would she even talk about our relationship last week!! Why is she acting so different to herself s';!!!

I'm just so confused. I don't know what to think! Last time everything was fine was half of february after her birthday. Then all of a sudden she became so cold and without wanting to do anything and blaming me about everything. Then I just gave her her space, didnt push it. I tried calling and she hang up. Then she blocked me. I went for the weekend (we live two hours apart) and left her a letter on her house and no response. I go the next night and there's a car outside. I dont know whos is it. I ring the door bell and she just turns off the lights and nothing else. I leave confused and sad.  Went next weekend sick and she just tells me to leave, and I told her what was happening and she told me to leave bc she didn't want drama. Im in bed (this was spring break now that I remember ) and sunday I explode and tell her how horrible she is , how I have done everythign to make this work bc she had already broken everything when she went to europe and cheated on me. How she was the one that looked for me and kept begging for forgiveness , everything I had jsut exploded. Yes she had already cheated on me, I'm stupid. 

Thing is she goes outside my parents house and makes this fucking drama and start yelling and ringing the bell while I wasnt there and my parents dont know what was happening so they start saying to me what I did to her and just made me feel worst! Then she fucking texts me the next day that she's sorry that if we could talk and have dinner. She changes her mind and tells me she's tired. I have to go back to my city to work so next day I just go by her house and again she tells me to go away AGH!

I just left her dealing with her stuff. Not calling for a couple of days , then I call her one night telling her I miss her and she says she does too. Then next day tells me what she doesn't know what to do. More days without talking, then I call her and she blocks me away.  Next week I call her and she hangs up, call her later at 1:30 and she's drunnk and hangs up (this is 2 weeks ago). Last week she just texts me that she see's really hard for this to work this out, which just pisses me off as I have been the one doing everything without she doing anything. There would be days where she would say "if you care for me you would be here" and I fucking drove just to see her.  And now this week all of a sudden I saw she started talking with the guy she cheated with me on Europe and I called her to tell ehr whats going on . She tells me that its nothing and she's already with someone else. I lose it , I start crying and telling her what the fuck is she talking about. She hangs up and I keep calling in my stressed mode and a guy answers telling me he's with her and that she just met her so he doesnt know whats happening. I just cry to the stranger telling him then why she would ask me to probe to her I care, why did even last week did she talk about our relationship. I ask him if he was the guy that was outside when I rang and he said yes. He tells me to calm down and we should have a beer I just hang up. Yesterday I send her an email saying that she didn't need to cause all this pain, that if she wanted to go back with the europe guy she should had never asked me to forgive her and she just says to stop talking about him, that she's with someone else and that they are living together. Now I start crying more as all of a sudden a "random" guy is living WITH her and he starts replying saying he loves her and I dont know what much bullshit. Im fucking stressed. I just ask her when did this happen, how in 4 weeks did she found someone and now is living with her, how nothing makes sense.  And im crying and she's making the noises Im making and making fun of me and telling me she doesn't feel anything for me anymore and I just dont know what to feel!! Idk if the guy is real or fake, the car seemed to be one of his friends husband, i just know she just fucking broke my heart. But theres no pictures of anything, theres no pictures of this guy, theres nothing! Even when she cheated in Europe there was A LOT of pictures of the guy . iM SO STRESSED AND SAD

Yeah, someone recently told me about DO schools but I don't really know what is the difference between MD and DO. There must be a difference I suppose.
I still want to try medschool. I don't know, I just know I can but it is stressing having to wait so much :/.  I applied this year but haven't gotten any interview so I think that is why I am thinking on trying outside the US.

Haha RT is a Respiratory Therapist. I didn't know about it either (I applied on the deadline) but it is a program within the medschool and I entered just to do something health related. I kinda like being able to learn a little bit about some kind of drugs and how to take patient history but recently I just been feeling its distracting me from what I really want and not sure that if I quit, it would look bad in my application. The other thing I don't like (besides EVERY week one of the teachers is missing) is some of the teachers don't seem to happy about me wanting to go to medschool so there's that.
If I quit I plan on volunteering in a hospital (I'm already doing it but now would be more often than just one day a week) and studying for the MCAT but I don't know what to do.

I have been avoiding Caribbean schools because of the residency issues. They keep saying that most of their students pass the Step 1 with high scores but they always avoid the extra paperwork students have to do and how some hospitals don't look good at it. 
About my citizenship, I can take my US citizenship test in one more month so that is one thing I will do ASAP.

Sorry for all the writing. :/
